name: Sebúlcor (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a yellow cross throughout, charged at the crossing with the municipal arms of Sebúlcor (a stone chest on red and a tree on yellow, parted by a wavy line).
history: Municipal flag of Sebúlcor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Sebúlcor arms — stone chest on red and tree on yellow, parted by a wavy line
